scope: Read-only remote audit. Only this report and requested public screenshot assets were written locally. No UI/source edits, deployments, repo updates, authentication attempts, submissions or payments.
methods: gh api repository root package.json and README.md; no private contents reproduced

findings: All eight requested URLs returned HTTP 200, but MuffinShop visibly fails during server rendering. HTTP status alone would give a false positive.
GetLine_Token, MeowMatch and TourPartnerHub are working sign-in entry points, not verified open application demos.
DilyShopTH, JustQR and DebugStudy expose verified public landing UIs.
Legacy justqr.vercel.app is not dead. generate-qr-liard.vercel.app is the configured repository homepage.
Do not present DebugStudy AI/scheduling/grades/email capabilities as verified implemented features; the current public page describes a platform foundation.
limitations: No account credentials were used. Protected dashboards and authenticated functionality were not audited.
A rendered landing page is not end-to-end application health verification.
Vercel project inventory supplied by the delegating context was not independently queried in this audit.
Private README text was read only in memory; private implementation details were deliberately excluded.
